sections.label: Body
sections.content:
Owner decisions resolved 2026-07-31 on srs#273; this note is the staged capture of the design-note-045 content promised there.

DECISION 1 — Extension-contributed Type facets (lifecycle, lifecycleRef, extendsTypeId/extendsTypeVersion/fieldOrder/fieldAssignmentOverrides, identityFieldId, validationRules, tags) are modelled as SEPARATE metamodel Types extending the core via ext:type-inheritance — not as optional Fields on the core Types. Rationale: optional-fields-on-core would assert extension facets at core-only adopters and flatten the very layering communities depend on for 'adopt only what you need'. The metamodel thereby self-hosts the extension mechanism and becomes a worked example of sovereign evolution.

Guardrail 1 (accepted cost, must stay explicit): any independent implementation consuming the metamodel as records must implement inheritance merging (ancestor chain + effective-field resolution). This raises the floor for a from-scratch reader and is accepted consciously — inheritance is core to the extensibility promise regardless.

DECISION 2 — FieldAssignment gains a per-context `description` (sibling of displayLabel). The seed's per-property-in-context documentation becomes structurally representable; the alternative (rewriting seed descriptions down to shared generic Field wording) permanently lowers documentation fidelity and was rejected.

Guardrail 2 (normative rule for the RFC): the slot is documentation-only. On conflict, the Field's own semantics and aiGuidance win; a contextual description that contradicts them is a data error, never an override. This is the first slot that could erode 'Field semantics are immutable', which is what makes cross-community Field reuse trustworthy.

Sequencing context: with #242 (fieldValues carrier) promoted ahead of #273 in the epic order, the deprecated FieldGroup/cardinality cluster leaves the seed before regeneration, so v1.1.0 models only the live surface and the annotation slot carries `description` alone (no `deprecated` projection needed). conditional-forbidden joins CrossFieldRuleKind with if/then projection in both byte-parity emitters.

Graduate this note to a com.semanticops.spec/design-note record when the RFC lands.
